title: Story map: the writer's story idea laid on a structure (written by Claude, built by story_template.py). Only the writer's own words are quoted; everything Claude adds is a question.

title.description: the writer's working title, if they gave one

story.description: the writer's story exactly as sent (typed or a voice-note transcript), untouched

why_structure.description: one sentence: why this structure fits this story's shape

quote.description: the writer's exact words for this element; leave out when the story doesn't say (that is a gap)

open_question.description: what is still open, as a question about THIS story

beats.description: beat id → the writer's fragments that may belong there, and questions about this story

name.description: as the writer calls them ("her uncle", «عمها»)

cost_note.description: a question about what it costs to shoot
